message: I am thinking...: Greenfield architecture: use Node built-in http + node:sqlite, no dependencies. Persist canonical sparse cell maps and immutable full snapshots per revision. Save trust boundary validates exact workbook/sheet identity and sparse cell schema, computes caller edits by diffing submitted snapshot against its base revision, intersects those edits with revision_changes after base, rejects overlap, otherwise applies only caller edits to current state in one transaction. This naturally preserves different-cell concurrent edits and prevents stale full payloads overwriting remote work. Browser owns a 100x26 div-based grid, one floating input editor, model, parser, selections and undo stacks. SSE handles presence and revision broadcasts; browser merges remote changed cells unless locally modified, in which case marks conflict.
